stem: After a test ends, an analyst chooses as guardrails the metrics that happened not to get worse. What is the problem?

options.text: None, as long as the success metric itself was fixed in the plan
None, once a Bonferroni correction is applied to the chosen guardrails
Guardrails chosen after the results can hide harm; they belong in the plan
Only that too few guardrails were chosen; reporting more metrics would fix it
